toolkit.name: Google BigQuery
toolkit.description: Google BigQuery is a fully managed data warehouse for large-scale data analytics, offering fast SQL queries and machine learning capabilities on massive datasets

tools.name: Create Analytics Hub Listing
tools.description: Tool to create a new listing in a BigQuery Analytics Hub data exchange. Use when you need to share a BigQuery dataset with specific subscribers or make it available for discovery. The dataset must exist and be in the same region as the data exchange.

input.title: CreateDataexchangesListingsRequest

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Required. The parent data exchange resource path in format 'projects/{projectId}/locations/{location}/dataExchanges/{dataExchangeId}'. The location must match the dataset location.

listingId.title: Listing Id
listingId.description: Required. The ID to use for the listing. Must contain only Unicode letters, numbers (0-9), underscores (_). Should not use characters that require URL-escaping, or characters outside of ASCII, spaces. Max length: 100 bytes.

publisher.title: Publisher

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the listing publisher. Max 100 bytes.

primaryContact.title: Primary Contact
primaryContact.description: Email or URL of the primary point of contact. Max 1000 bytes.

publisher.description: Details of the publisher who owns the listing.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Optional. Categories of the listing. Up to two categories are allowed. Helps subscribers discover relevant data.

description.title: Description
examples: Quarterly sales data including revenue, transactions, and customer segments
description.description: Optional. Short description of the listing. Max 2000 bytes. Use this to explain what data the listing contains and how it can be used.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Required. Human-readable display name of the listing. Max 63 bytes. Supports Unicode letters, numbers, underscores, dashes, spaces, ampersands.

dataProvider.title: DataProvider

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the data provider. Max 100 bytes.

primaryContact.title: Primary Contact
primaryContact.description: Email or URL of the primary point of contact. Max 1000 bytes.

dataProvider.description: Details of the data provider who owns the source data.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Optional. Documentation describing the listing in detail. Can include usage instructions, schema details, and data lineage information.

requestAccess.title: Request Access
requestAccess.description: Optional. Email or URL where users can request access to the listing. Max 1000 bytes.

primaryContact.title: Primary Contact
primaryContact.description: Optional. Email or URL of the primary point of contact for the listing. Max 1000 bytes.

bigqueryDataset.title: Bigquery Dataset

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: The BigQuery dataset resource name in the format 'projects/{projectId}/datasets/{datasetId}'. This dataset will be shared through the listing.

bigqueryDataset.description: Required. The BigQuery dataset source to be shared. This dataset must exist and be in the same region as the data exchange.

input.description: Request model for creating an Analytics Hub listing.

tools.name: Create BigQuery Dataset
tools.description: Tool to create a new BigQuery dataset with explicit location, labels, and description using the BigQuery Datasets API. Use when the workflow needs to set up a staging/warehouse dataset and correctness of region is critical to avoid downstream job location mismatches. Surfaces 409 Already Exists errors cleanly without retrying.

input.title: CreateDatasetRequest

items.title: AccessEntry

role.title: Role
role.description: Role granted to the entity. Examples: 'READER', 'WRITER', 'OWNER'.

view.title: View
view.description: A view from a different dataset to grant access to. Specify projectId, datasetId, and tableId.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: A domain to grant access to.

routine.title: Routine
routine.description: A routine from a different dataset to grant access to. Specify projectId, datasetId, and routineId.

iamMember.title: Iam Member
iamMember.description: IAM member in the form 'user:email', 'group:email', 'serviceAccount:email', or 'domain:domain'.

userByEmail.title: User By Email
userByEmail.description: Email address of a user to grant access to.

groupByEmail.title: Group By Email
groupByEmail.description: Email address of a Google Group to grant access to.

specialGroup.title: Special Group
specialGroup.description: A special group to grant access to. Examples: 'projectReaders', 'projectWriters', 'projectOwners', 'allAuthenticatedUsers'.

items.description: Access control entry for dataset permissions.

access.title: Access
access.description: Access control list (ACL) for the dataset. If not specified, the dataset inherits project-level permissions.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels to organize and categorize the dataset. Labels are key-value pairs. Keys and values must be lowercase, max 63 characters.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location where the dataset should reside. This is CRITICAL to avoid location-related query/job errors. Examples: 'US', 'EU', 'us-central1', 'europe-west1'.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: The dataset ID. Must be unique within the project. Use alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The project ID where the dataset will be created. This is used in the URL path, not in the request body.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the dataset. Use this to document the dataset's purpose and contents.

friendly_name.title: Friendly Name
friendly_name.description: A user-friendly name for the dataset. This is a descriptive label that appears in the BigQuery UI.

defaultTableExpirationMs.title: Default Table Expiration Ms
defaultTableExpirationMs.description: Default lifetime of all tables in the dataset, in milliseconds. Tables will be deleted this many milliseconds after creation unless explicitly set otherwise.

defaultPartitionExpirationMs.title: Default Partition Expiration Ms
defaultPartitionExpirationMs.description: Default lifetime of all partitions in tables in the dataset, in milliseconds. Partitions will be deleted this many milliseconds after creation.

input.description: Request model for creating a BigQuery dataset.

rangeElementType.title: Range Element Type

returnType.description:
Data type of a BigQuery field or function argument.

examples: A simple function that doubles an integer value

routineType.title: Routine Type
routineType.description: Required. The type of routine: SCALAR_FUNCTION, PROCEDURE, TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION, or AGGREGATE_FUNCTION.

columns.title: Columns

routineReference.title: Routine Reference

projectId.title: Project Id

routineId.title: Routine Id
routineId.description: Required. The ID of the routine. Must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), or underscores (_). Maximum length is 256 characters.

If jobComplete is false, you can continue to wait for the query to complete by calling the getQueryResults method until the jobComplete field in the getQueryResults response is true. Optional.

tools.name: Insert Data into BigQuery Table
tools.description: Tool to stream data into BigQuery one record at a time without running a load job. Use when you need immediate data availability or inserting small batches. Supports row-level deduplication via insertId and error handling via skipInvalidRows.

input.title: InsertAllRequest

items.title: RowData

json.title: Json
json.description: The actual row data as a JSON object. Keys must match the table schema field names. Example: {'column1': 'value1', 'column2': 123}.

insertId.title: Insert Id
insertId.description: Optional unique ID for this row to enable deduplication. If provided, BigQuery uses this to detect and ignore duplicate insert requests within a certain time window. Recommended for idempotent inserts.

items.description: Data for a single insertion row.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Required. Array of rows to insert. Each row contains the data to be inserted as a JSON object. At least one row must be provided.

traceId.title: Trace Id
traceId.description: Optional. Unique request trace ID for debugging. Case-sensitive, up to 36 ASCII characters. A UUID is recommended.

table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: Required. Table ID of the destination table.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: Required. Dataset ID of the destination table.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Required. Project ID of the destination table.

templateSuffix.title: Template Suffix
templateSuffix.description: Optional. If specified, treats the destination table as a base template and inserts rows into an instance table named '{destination}{templateSuffix}'. Useful for table sharding patterns.

skipInvalidRows.title: Skip Invalid Rows
skipInvalidRows.description: Optional. If true, insert all valid rows even if some rows are invalid. If false (default), the entire request fails if any row is invalid.

ignoreUnknownValues.title: Ignore Unknown Values
ignoreUnknownValues.description: Optional. If true, accept rows with values that don't match the schema and ignore the unknown values. If false (default), treat unknown values as errors.

field.description: Required. The table is partitioned by this field. The field must be a top-level NULLABLE/REQUIRED field.

range.title: RangePartitioningRange

end.title: End
end.description: The end of range partitioning, exclusive.

start.title: Start
start.description: The start of range partitioning, inclusive.

range.description: Defines the ranges for range partitioning.

rangePartitioning.description: Configures range-based partitioning for the table.

requirePartitionFilter.title: Require Partition Filter
requirePartitionFilter.description: Optional. If set to true, queries over this table require a partition filter.

kmsKeyName.title: Kms Key Name
kmsKeyName.description: Optional. Describes the Cloud KMS encryption key that will be used to protect destination BigQuery table.

items.title: TableFieldSchema

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The field mode (NULLABLE, REQUIRED, or REPEATED).

type.title: Type
type.description: The field data type (e.g., STRING, INTEGER, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, TIMESTAMP, DATE, RECORD, etc.).

items.description: Schema definition for a table field.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Describes the fields in a table.

autodetect.title: Autodetect
autodetect.description: Try to detect schema and format options automatically.

sourceUris.title: Source Uris
sourceUris.description: Required. The fully-qualified URIs that point to your data in Google Cloud.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Optional. The compression type of the data source. Possible values include GZIP and NONE.

sourceFormat.title: Source Format
sourceFormat.description: Required. The data format. For CSV files, specify 'CSV'. For JSON, specify 'NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON'. For Avro, specify 'AVRO', etc.

maxBadRecords.title: Max Bad Records
maxBadRecords.description: Optional. The maximum number of bad records that BigQuery can ignore when reading data.

ignoreUnknownValues.title: Ignore Unknown Values
ignoreUnknownValues.description: Optional. Indicates if BigQuery should allow extra values that are not represented in the table schema.

input.description: Request model for updating a BigQuery table.
